title: ValhallaTraceAttributesResponse
description: Attributes of the road network along a matched trace.

admins.description: Countries and states the matched path passes through. Each field is absent when unknown.

alternate_paths.description: Other plausible matches. Always present, and empty when the trace matched one way only. Each holds the same path fields as the response itself: `osm_changeset`, `shape`, `confidence_score`, `raw_score`, `admins`, `edges`, `elevation_interval`, `elevation`, `matched_points`, and `shape_attributes`.

confidence_score.description: How confident the matcher is, from 0 to 1.

edges.description: Edges the trace was matched onto, in order.

elevation.description: Elevation along the path, sampled every `elevation_interval`. Present with `elevation_interval`.

elevation_interval.description: Spacing of the `elevation` samples, in meters, or feet when `units` is `miles`. Present when the request sets `elevation_interval`.

id.description: The request's `id`, echoed back. Absent when the request has none.

matched_points.description: One entry per input point, describing how it was matched.

osm_changeset.description: OpenStreetMap changeset the tiles were built from.

raw_score.description: Unnormalized matching score. Lower is a closer match.

shape.description: The matched path, as an encoded polyline.

units.description: Units the lengths, speeds, and elevations are expressed in.

warnings.description: Non-fatal notes about the request. Absent when there are none.

ValhallaAdmin.description: A country and, where known, the state or province within it.

state_code.description: ISO 3166-2 subdivision code, without the country prefix.

ValhallaEdgeSurface.description: Road surface, from smoothest to roughest.

ValhallaEdgeUse.description: What the edge is used for.

ValhallaMatchedPoint.description: How one input point was matched to the network.

begin_route_discontinuity.description: Whether the path breaks before this point, as when the trace jumps. Present only when true.

distance_along_edge.description: How far along that edge the point falls, from 0 to 1. Absent for unmatched points.

distance_from_trace_point.description: Distance in meters from the input point to the matched point. Absent for unmatched points.

edge_index.description: Index into `edges` of the edge this point matched. Absent for unmatched points.

end_route_discontinuity.description: Whether the path breaks after this point. Present only when true.

type.description: Whether the point was matched, interpolated between matches, or left unmatched.

ValhallaShapeAttributes.description: Values for each segment between consecutive points of `shape`. Off by default: each list appears only when its `shape_attributes.*` filter is requested.

begin_shape_index.description: Index into `shape` where the closure starts.

end_shape_index.description: Index into `shape` where the closure ends.

congestion.description: Congestion on each segment, from live traffic.

length.description: Length of each segment, in kilometers.

speed.description: Speed on each segment, in km/h.

speed_limit.description: Posted speed limit on each segment, in km/h.

time.description: Time to travel each segment, in seconds.

ValhallaTraceAttributesPath.description: One alternate match of the trace.

admins.description: Countries and states the path passes through.

confidence_score.description: How confident the matcher is, from 0 to 1.

edges.description: Edges of this match, in order.

osm_changeset.description: OpenStreetMap changeset the tiles were built from.

raw_score.description: Unnormalized matching score. Lower is a closer match.

shape.description: The matched path, as an encoded polyline.

ValhallaTraceEdge.description: One edge of the matched path. Speeds are in km/h, or mph when `units` is `miles`.

begin_heading.description: Compass bearing at the start of the edge, in degrees.

begin_shape_index.description: Index into `shape` where the edge starts.

bicycle_network.description: Signed bicycle networks, as a bit mask. 1 national, 2 regional, 4 local, 8 mountain.

bridge.description: Whether the edge is a bridge.

country_crossing.description: Whether the edge crosses a country border.

curvature.description: Curvature, from 0 for straight to 15. Off by default.

density.description: Road density around the edge, from 0 to 15.

drive_on_right.description: Whether traffic drives on the right.

end_heading.description: Compass bearing at the end of the edge, in degrees.

end_shape_index.description: Index into `shape` where the edge ends.

forward.description: Whether the path runs in the direction of the edge's shape.

hov_type.description: Occupancy requirement, meaningful only on HOV-only edges. Off by default; once requested it is on every edge, and ordinary roads read `HOV-2`.

internal_intersection.description: Whether the edge is internal to an intersection.

lane_connectivity.description: Which lanes on the incoming way lead to which lanes on this edge. Present only when the data has lane connectivity.

from.description: OpenStreetMap way the lanes come from.

from_lanes.description: Lanes on that way, as a `|`-separated list of lane numbers.

to_lanes.description: Lanes on this edge they lead to, in the same form.

lane_count.description: Number of lanes in the direction of travel.

length.description: Length of the traversed part of the edge, in the response's units.

levels.description: Building levels the edge spans, as `[from, to]` pairs. Present only where the data has levels.

max_downward_grade.description: Steepest downward slope, in degrees. -500 when the tiles have no elevation data.

max_upward_grade.description: Steepest upward slope, in degrees. -500 when the tiles have no elevation data.

mean_elevation.description: Mean elevation in meters, or feet when `units` is `miles`. Absent when the tiles have no elevation data.

names.description: Street names and route numbers. Absent when the edge has none.

node_id.description: OpenStreetMap node the edge starts at. Present only when the tiles were built with node identifiers.

roundabout.description: Whether the edge is part of a roundabout.

sac_scale.description: Hiking difficulty, from 0 for none to 6 for difficult alpine hiking.

shoulder.description: Whether the edge has a shoulder.

sidewalk.description: Which sides of the edge have a sidewalk.

sign.description: Guide-sign text on the edge. Present only where the edge has signs, and each list only when the sign carries it.

exit_branch.description: Route numbers or street names the exit leads onto.

source_percent_along.description: Where the path enters the edge, from 0 to 1. Present only when not 0.

speed.description: Speed the router used for the edge.

speed_limit.description: Posted speed limit, or `unlimited`. Absent when unknown.

speed_type.description: Whether the speed came from a tagged maxspeed or was assigned by road class.

target_percent_along.description: Where the path leaves the edge, from 0 to 1. Present only when not 1.

toll.description: Whether the edge is a toll road.

traffic_segments.description: Traffic segments the edge belongs to. Present only when traffic segment data is loaded.

begin_percent.description: Where the edge starts along the segment, from 0 to 1.

end_percent.description: Where the edge ends along the segment, from 0 to 1.

ends_segment.description: Whether the segment ends on this edge.

starts_segment.description: Whether the segment starts on this edge.

traffic_signal.description: Whether there is a traffic signal on the edge.

travel_mode.description: Mode of travel on the edge.

traversability.description: Which directions the edge can be traveled in by the request's mode.

truck_route.description: Whether the edge is a designated truck route.

truck_speed.description: Truck speed. Absent when the edge has none.

tunnel.description: Whether the edge is a tunnel.

vehicle_type.description: Vehicle type, for drive edges: `car`, `motorcycle`, `bus`, or `truck`. Motor scooter costing returns the string `null`.

way_id.description: OpenStreetMap way the edge was built from.

weighted_grade.description: Grade in percent, weighted toward steeper sections.

ValhallaTraceEdgeSpeeds.description: The speed from each traffic source. `speeds_non_faded` is the source's own value; `speeds_faded` blends live traffic into the historical speed with distance from the start of the route, and appears only when the request's `date_time` is the current time. Each source is absent when the edge has none, except `no_flow`.

no_flow.description: Speed with no traffic data, from tags or road class.

predicted_flow.description: Historical speed at the time of travel.

ValhallaTraceNode.description: The node at the end of an edge.

admin_index.description: Index into `admins` of the area the node is in.

elapsed_cost.description: Cost from the start of the path to the node.

elapsed_time.description: Time from the start of the path to the node, in seconds.

fork.description: Whether the node is a fork in the road.

intersecting_edges.description: Other edges meeting at the node. Absent when there are none.

begin_heading.description: Compass bearing leaving the node, in degrees.

cyclability.description: Directions a bicycle can travel the edge in. Absent when none.

driveability.description: Directions a car can travel the edge in. Absent when none.

from_edge_name_consistency.description: Whether the edge shares a name with the edge entering the node.

to_edge_name_consistency.description: Whether the edge shares a name with the edge leaving the node.

walkability.description: Directions a pedestrian can travel the edge in. Absent when none.

node_id.description: OpenStreetMap node. Present only when the tiles were built with node identifiers.

time_zone.description: IANA time zone at the node. Absent when unknown.

traffic_signal.description: Whether the node has a traffic signal.

transition_time.description: Time spent passing through the node, as for a turn, in seconds.

ValhallaTripWarning.description: A non-fatal note about the request.
